entries.d5f0936f29838c7e: To survive in the competitive sales environment of the food industry, the company is managing its business with a focus on establishing a supply system that puts safety and security first and building trust, speeding up product development and strengthening sales capabilities, forming a resilient management base through group-wide cost reduction and labor-saving and efficiency measures, and securing personnel through work style reform and personnel rotation.
